biological_question: Can the 13 frozen contact records be measured in existing spatial RNA above negative-probe background with defensible endpoint lineage and analysis units?
native_genes: Exact unique var/_index or gene_symbol aliases; absent or ambiguous is missing, not negative. Full native X determines RNA totals and detected genes; all original cells retained in cache.
background: Recover all raw negative controls by fov+cell_ID. FOV-specific empirical pooled per-cell/per-negative-probe 95th percentile. Gene count must exceed this percentile and 0. Descriptive background diagnostic, not gene-specific error/FDR calibration.
QC: Sensitivity only: native target RNA >30 and finite positive Area <5*exp(mean(log(positive finite Area))) within each file; not asserted to reproduce author QC for GSE287472.
endpoint: At least 2 independent T/B lineage markers positive under the same count/background rule, plus family name marker and ALL fixed ligand/receptor components positive in the SAME cell. Exclude candidate LR/name genes from lineage panels. Pure arm excludes cells with >=2 competing T/B, My or Epi markers. Mixed lineage remains explicitly counted. No subtype/state labels assigned.
overlap: CCL5+ and IL7R+ may overlap. Inclusive membership, endpoint overlap separately reported; same cell never counts as a physical contact pair. No overlap cells silently removed.
programme: Exact matched fixed336 program_genes per model_key; do not change genes based on spatial results. Report >=4 measurable and >=60% remaining-program coverage. Missing programme does not erase endpoint-only result.
units: FOV/file/platform not independent patients. Patient/core map unreviewed => patient-level inference unavailable. Count per-FOV endpoint>=20 for descriptive feasibility only. No proximity test or p-value in this milestone.
author_annotation: Two public original RDS, exact TMA-prefix+fov+cell_ID join. QC-filtered absence is unannotated, not non-T/non-B. Original labels and marker-defined populations compared; no states promoted.
acceptance: Exactly 5 files and 254458 cells; exact 13 frozen keys x5, no replacement endpoints
Every native control row joined or explicit failure; no missing filled zero
Independent recount of gene values, full RNA/genes, controls, aliases, QC, background thresholds, author key mapping and all65 x5 arms
Independent native keys/counts/coords unchanged; preserved old inputs
All missing/zero/mixed/overlap cases explicit; unmapped units do not support patient inference
